verdict.summary: Core F1–F7 fixes are independently reproduced: main 5 tasks x A/B2 = 10 and B1 3 x B1 = 3 strict preflights pass; self-test rejects 10 negative mutations; six fixtures pass (S1 ord-3, S2 NoneType, S3 Settings.verbose/no parse_date); 84/84 archive hashes; npm run verify 285+45 tests and 12 smoke; no packages/sdlc changes; PR #26 is draft base dev head dcc5d93.
